abstract: Decentralised finance data presents a distinctive paradox: while every data point is publicly recorded and accessible, deriving meaningful insights is obscured by the scale, fragmentation and complexity of the ecosystem. Key metrics illustrate that the rapidly evolving DeFi ecosystem introduces unique challenges for economic and financial research in accurately capturing financial activity in DeFi.
title: Hidden by complexity? Measuring stablecoin, crypto and decentralised finance ecosystems

abstract: Economic uncertainty can discourage firms’ investment and employment decisions, yet its effects are difficult to measure and may vary considerably across firms and sectors. We examine these effects in Greece, a euro area economy that has experienced successive large shocks and substantial fluctuations in uncertainty during the last two decades. Using microdata from Business and Consumer Surveys (BCS), we construct new complementary business uncertainty indices based on ex-ante forecast disagreement and ex-post forecast errors, together with a firm-level measure of the perceived difficulty of predicting future business activity. These measures are positively correlated with existing uncertainty indicators while enabling more granular analysis across sectors and firms. The macroeconometric results indicate that increases in uncertainty are associated with substantial and persistent declines in investment and employment, lasting beyond one year. The microeconometric analysis further reveals significant heterogeneity and asymmetry in these effects, which depend on firms’ expectations, sectoral characteristics, and size, and are generally stronger among smaller firms and when expectations are negative. The findings demonstrate the value of business-survey data for systematically measuring and monitoring uncertainty and assessing its implications for real economic activity. Such measurement enables the identification of constraints faced by firms and provides insights for the design and implementation of policy measures aimed at mitigating the adverse effects of uncertainty and strengthening economic resilience.
title: Measuring Economic Uncertainty and Its Effects on Investment and Employment: Evidence from Greece

abstract: This paper presents a framework for assessing the economic consequences of AI between 2026 and 2030. In the model, AI automates a growing share of cognitive work, raising productivity and displacing workers who must search for jobs in other occupations. The model maps future paths of AI capabilities into implied paths for GDP, the labor share, wages, labor reallocation, and unemployment. We illustrate the framework by considering three scenarios: modest, substantial, and extreme. Under modest change, AI adds less than half a point to GDP growth by 2030 and raises unemployment by a tenth of a point. In the extreme change scenario, AI has transformative effects, with AI performing almost half of today's cognitive work by 2030. GDP growth then rises to 15 percent per year, the labor share of income falls from 60 to 45 percent, and nearly one in five cognitive workers is unemployed. We also surveyed US adults about their expectations for AI. Views vary widely, but the median respondent's answers are consistent with our substantial change scenario in which, by 2030, GDP rises by 8 percent and cognitive employment declines by 4 percent. The model offers a structured way to compare possibilities for our economic future under different expectations about AI.
title: Economic Scenarios for Transformative AI

abstract: Climate change affects agricultural land productivity. This risk is more pronounced in agrarian economies, where land constitutes farmers' primary asset. Existing research has largely focused on the effects of climate change on crop yields or income, and with limited attention to how climate change is capitalized into parcel-level land prices in emerging markets. This study addresses the gap by estimating price discounts associated with RCP4.5/8.5 climate scenarios for individual land parcels, controlling for parcel-level micro-location attributes. A sample of land price data (2019–2024) from the coastal state of India, Andhra Pradesh, reveals that markets incorporate climate risks into land prices. Specifically, each 1% increase in rainfall is associated with 3% increase in land price, but a 1°C increase in projected temperature corresponds to about 47% decline in price. The net effect diverges across segments: rural parcels benefit under extreme climate change scenarios, whereas median and urbanizing segments experience 20–35% price declines. The study also finds that micro-location factors explain up to 60% of price variation, exceeding the explanatory power of district fixed effects. Parcel size shows diminishing returns: a 1% increase raises price by only 0.66–0.72%. Proximity to highways generates 12–15% price premiums, while proximity to expressways is associated with premiums exceeding 130%.
title: Impact of climate change on agricultural land prices

abstract: Extreme climate risks and farmland structural constraints are intensifying agricultural vulnerability, making the improvement of climate-smart agriculture (CSA) essential for enhancing agricultural resilience and sustainability. High-standard farmland construction (HSFC) represents an important practice for advancing CSA by improving cultivated land quality and farmland infrastructure. However, existing studies have mainly examined HSFC’s effects on single outcomes, including yield, efficiency, or environmental performance, with insufficient attention to whether it can simultaneously advance multiple CSA objectives or generate synergies and trade-offs among them. To examine the multidimensional linkages between HSFC and CSA, this study proposes an integrated Pressure-State-Response-Objective (PSRO) analytical framework. Using 2003–2022 panel data for 122 counties in Hunan Province, we apply a continuous difference-in-differences (DID) model and mechanism tests to estimate HSFC’s policy effects and assess transmission through input optimization, technology upgrading, and cultivated-land habitat quality. Results show that (1) HSFC has a positive and significant policy effect on CSA, with estimated coefficients of about 0.011–0.012 across specifications; (2) HSFC positively influences CSA in pillars food security and climate adaptation, but negatively affects pillar carbon mitigation in the short term; (3) heterogeneous effects are evident across regions, with stronger impacts where regional development conditions and land-consolidation potential are more favorable; (4) CSA gains from HSFC arise from improved farmland production conditions, reduced per-output input pressure, and complementary technological and cultivated-land habitat improvements. This study links a land-consolidation mega-program with a multi-pillar CSA index under an integrated PSRO framework and offers guidance for coordinating food security, climate resilience, and carbon mitigation.

title: Unveiling the impacts of high-standard farmland construction on climate-smart agriculture

abstract: In this paper, we construct a hospital-level panel dataset covering the entire US hospital industry over the period 1996-2018. Using detailed hospital-level expenditure and revenue data, we measure hospital level markups and document industry-wide increasing markups of about 17 percent. We relate markups to merger activity acrosshospital markets, and we find a strong association between markups and mergers at the market level. In particular, we find that mergers, on average, explain about 3 of the 17 percent increase in markups over our sample period. Our results indicate that market level markups do not increase due to reallocation of market shares to higher markup hospitals, rather by an increase of markups at hospitals involved in mergers. We confirm that hospital system-wide mergers are the main factor driving the estimated merger-markup association; hereby strengthening the merged system’s ability to negotiate prices with insurers.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个涵盖1996—2018年整个美国医院产业的医院层面面板数据集。利用详细的医院层面支出与收入数据，我们测度了医院层面的加成率，并记录了全行业加成率上升约17%的现象。我们将加成率与跨医院市场的并购活动相关联，发现市场层面的加成率与并购之间存在强关联。具体而言，我们发现并购平均解释了我们样本期内17%加成率增长中的约3个百分点。我们的结果表明，市场层面加成率的上升并非源于市场份额向高加成率医院重新配置，而是源于参与并购的医院自身加成率的提高。我们确认，医院系统层面的并购是驱动所估计的并购—加成率关联的主要因素；由此增强了合并后系统与保险公司进行价格谈判的能力。
title: Markups and Mergers in the US Hospital Industry
title_zh: 美国医院行业的加价与并购

abstract: Identifying the impact of capital inflows on output is challenging because inflows are forward-looking and respond to expectations about future economic conditions. We develop a new measure of capital inflow shocks using a simple and broadly applicable expectations-based framework that isolates the unexpected component of inflows by purging movements predicted by professional forecasters’ expectations. Estimates using the new measure for 27 emerging market economies indicate that capital inflows have sizable expansionary effects on output, operating through stronger domestic consumption and investment and easier financing conditions. Additional analysis indicates that equity-type inflows generate greater and more persistent effects than debt-type inflows, while large inflow reversals result in more pronounced effects than comparable increases in inflows. These results are robust to a wide range of alternative specifications.
abstract_zh: 识别资本流入对产出的影响具有挑战性，因为资本流入具有前瞻性，并会对未来经济状况的预期作出反应。我们使用一个简单且广泛适用的基于预期的框架，构建了一种新的资本流入冲击度量，通过剔除专业预测者预期所预测的变动，分离出资本流入中未预期的成分。使用这一新度量对27个新兴市场经济体进行的估计表明，资本流入对产出具有相当大的扩张效应，其作用通过更强的国内消费和投资以及更宽松的融资条件实现。进一步分析表明，股权型流入比债务型流入产生更大且更持久的效应，而大规模流入逆转所产生的影响比可比规模的流入增加更为显著。这些结果在多种替代设定下均保持稳健。
title: Expectations-Based Capital Inflow Shocks
title_zh: 基于预期的资本流入冲击

abstract: Using original survey data from parents of children in kindergarten through junior high school in Tokyo, Japan, we find that parents exhibit stronger preferences for sons over daughters to participate in extracurricular Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) activities, with the gender gap widening as children age. Parents aspiring for their children to pursue STEM degrees prioritize science classes more, a preference more often directed towards boys. These gendered differences affect children’s early exposure to science. Since Japanese students choose between science and humanities tracks by eleventh grade, early disparities may limit girls’ opportunities. Promoting equal STEM access is crucial to reducing these gender gaps. KEYWORDS: Science learning STEM gender Japan JEL CLASSIFICATION: A21 I24 J13 J16 Acknowledgements For helpful comments and suggestions, we would like to thank three anonymous referees, Atsuko Ichikawa, Noriko Osumi, Esturo Shioji, Kan Takeuchi, and participants in meetings held at Hitotsubashi University, Nihon University, Tohoku University, the University of Auckland, the 23rd Science Council of Asia Conference, and the Science Council of Japan, Committee on Physics, Subcommittee on Physics Education.
abstract_zh: 利用来自日本东京幼儿园至初中儿童家长的原始调查数据，我们发现，家长在让子女参与课外科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）活动方面，表现出对儿子强于女儿的偏好，且这种性别差距随着孩子年龄增长而扩大。期望子女攻读STEM学位的家长更重视科学课程，而这种偏好更常指向男孩。这些性别差异影响了儿童早期接触科学的机会。由于日本学生在十一年级时要在理科与文科方向之间做出选择，早期差异可能限制女孩的机会。促进STEM领域的平等参与对于缩小这些性别差距至关重要。关键词：科学学习 STEM 性别 日本 JEL分类：A21 I24 J13 J16 致谢 感谢三位匿名审稿人、市川敦子、大隅典子、盐路悦郎、竹内干，以及一桥大学、日本大学、东北大学、奥克兰大学、第23届亚洲科学理事会会议和日本学术会议物理学委员会物理教育分委员会会议上与会者提供的有益评论和建议。
title: Gender differences in children’s extracurricular activities: Japanese parental preference for science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) activities for sons
title_zh: 儿童课外活动中的性别差异：日本父母对儿子参与科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）活动的偏好

abstract: This paper examines how local residents form beliefs about internal migrants and how these beliefs translate into perceived social exclusion in destination cities. Using nationally representative data from China, it documents systematic differences in perceived exclusion across migrants from different hometowns, even after controlling for personal characteristics including education and occupation. The paper then studies a belief-formation framework in which perceived acceptance reflects both individual-level information and origin-based priors linked to migrants’ hometown economic reputation. Dialect distance and social participation affect how much residents rely on personal information, while crowding in the destination city raises the standard for acceptance. The results suggest that information frictions are an important source of origin-based exclusion, and imply that policies improving interaction and information flow can substantially mitigate it. KEYWORDS: Internal migration regional discrimination social exclusion information frictions JEL CLASSIFICATION: J15 J61 J71 R23
abstract_zh: 本文考察了本地居民如何形成关于国内流动人口的信念，以及这些信念如何转化为流入城市中被感知的社会排斥。利用中国具有全国代表性的数据，本文记录了来自不同家乡的流动人口在感知排斥方面存在的系统性差异，即使在控制了包括教育和职业在内的个人特征之后依然如此。本文随后研究了一个信念形成框架，其中感知到的接纳程度既反映个体层面的信息，也反映与流动人口家乡经济声誉相关的、基于来源地的先验信念。方言距离和社会参与会影响居民对个人信息依赖的程度，而流入城市中的拥挤程度则提高了接纳的标准。结果表明，信息摩擦是基于来源地排斥的一个重要来源，并意味着改善互动和信息流动的政策能够大幅缓解这种排斥。关键词：国内迁移 地区歧视 社会排斥 信息摩擦 JEL分类：J15 J61 J71 R23

abstract: This paper studies housing tenure and voting patterns during the period from July 2013 to July 2023 in Israel, where the rental share of housing units increased from 24% to 29%, and six national elections for parliament took place. Using detailed neighbourhood panel data on rental units share and electoral outcomes, I find that switching a neighbourhood's housing stock from fully owner‐occupied into fully rental causes the turnout rate to decrease by 8–10 percentage points. These effects are interpreted with the aid of census and survey data, a fixed effects model and a control function approach. The findings contribute to understanding how housing market dynamics influence democracies.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2013年7月至2023年7月期间以色列的住房产权与投票模式，在此期间，租赁住房单元占比从24%上升至29%，并举行了六次全国议会选举。利用关于租赁单元占比和选举结果的详细社区面板数据，我发现将一个社区的住房存量从完全自有转变为完全租赁会导致投票率下降8至10个百分点。这些效应借助人口普查和调查数据、固定效应模型以及控制函数方法加以解释。这些发现有助于理解住房市场动态如何影响民主制度。
title: Electoral impact of the rental market: evidence from Israel
title_zh: 租赁市场对选举的影响：来自以色列的证据

abstract: We ask whether epidemic exposure leads to a shift in financial technology usage and who participates in this shift. We exploit a dataset combining Gallup World Polls and Global Findex surveys for some 250,000 individuals in 140 countries, merging them with information on the incidence of epidemics and local 3G internet infrastructure. Epidemic exposure is associated with an increase in remote-access (online/mobile) banking and substitution from bank branch-based to ATM activity. The temporary nature of the effects we identify is more consistent with a demand channel rather than that of supply with high initial fixed costs. Exploring heterogeneity using a machine-learning driven approach, we find that young, high-income earners in full-time employment have the greatest tendency to shift to online/mobile transactions in response to epidemics. Baseline effects are larger for individuals with better ex ante 3G signal coverage, highlighting the role of the digital divide in adaption to new technologies necessitated by adverse external shocks.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨疫情暴露是否会导致金融科技使用方式的转变，以及哪些群体参与了这一转变。我们利用一个数据集，该数据集结合了盖洛普世界民意调查和全球金融普惠调查，涵盖140个国家约25万名个体，并将其与疫情发生情况和当地3G互联网基础设施信息进行合并。疫情暴露与远程访问（在线/移动）银行使用的增加以及从银行网点业务向ATM业务的替代相关。我们所识别效应的暂时性特征，更符合需求渠道，而非具有较高初始固定成本的供给渠道。我们使用机器学习驱动的方法探讨异质性，发现年轻、高收入、从事全职工作的劳动者在应对疫情时最倾向于转向在线/移动交易。对于事前3G信号覆盖更好的个体，基准效应更大，这凸显了数字鸿沟在适应不利外部冲击所催生的新技术方面的作用。
title: Epidemic Exposure, Fintech Adoption, and the Digital Divide
title_zh: 疫情暴露、金融科技采用与数字鸿沟

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of a large immigration shock on firms' R&D investments. We examine the impact of the sudden influx of immigration to Norway after the Eastern enlargement of the European Union, and the extent to which the increased immigration penetration contributed to the observed overall decline in R&D in the business sector. To identify the effect of immigration we exploit the fact that firms differ in their occupational mix and that the exposure to increased immigration varies across occupations. In our empirical approach we exploit that language requirements are significant barriers for foreign workers, and that these requirements vary across occupations. The results suggest that the immigration shock had a negative impact on firms' R&D investments with potential long term effects on productivity growth.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了大规模移民冲击对企业研发投资的影响。我们研究了欧盟东扩后移民突然涌入挪威所产生的影响，以及移民渗透度上升在多大程度上导致了商业部门研发的整体下降。为识别移民的影响，我们利用企业职业构成存在差异这一事实，以及不同职业所受到的移民增加冲击程度各不相同。在实证方法中，我们利用语言要求是外籍工人的重要障碍，且这些要求因职业而异这一特点。结果表明，移民冲击对企业研发投资产生了负面影响，并可能对生产率增长带来长期影响。
title: Reduced R&D Investments: A Flip Side of Immigration?
title_zh: 研发投资减少：移民的另一面？

abstract: We argue that alternative COVID-19 vaccine dosing regimens could potentially dramatically accelerate global COVID-19 vaccination and reduce mortality, and that the costs of testing these regimens are dwarfed by their potential benefits.We first use the high correlation between neutralizing antibody response and efficacy against disease (Khoury et.al. 2021) to show that half or even quarter doses of some vaccines generate immune responses associated with high vaccine efficacy.We then use an SEIR model to estimate that under these efficacy levels, doubling or quadrupling the rate of vaccination by using fractional doses would dramatically reduce infections and mortality.Since the correlation between immune response and efficacy may not be fully predictive of efficacy with fractional doses, we then use the SEIR model to show that fractional dosing would substantially reduce infections and mortality over a wide range of plausible efficacy levels.Further immunogenicity studies for a range of vaccine and dose combinations could deliver outcomes in weeks and could be conducted with a few hundred healthy volunteers.National regulatory authorities could also decide to test efficacy of fractional dosing in the context of vaccination campaigns based on existing immune response data, as some did for delayed second doses.If efficacy turned out to be high, the approach could be implemented broadly, while if it turned out to be low, downside risk could be limited by administering full doses to those who had received fractional doses.The SEIR model also suggests that delaying second vaccine doses will likely have substantial mortality benefits for multiple, but not all, vaccine-variant combinations, underscoring the importance of ongoing surveillance.Finally, we find that for countries choosing between approved but lower efficacy vaccines available immediately and waiting for mRNA vaccines, using immediately available vaccines typically reduces mortality.
abstract_zh: 我们认为，替代性COVID-19疫苗给药方案可能大幅加速全球COVID-19疫苗接种并降低死亡率，而测试这些方案的成本与其潜在收益相比微不足道。我们首先利用中和抗体反应与疾病保护效力之间的高度相关性（Khoury等，2021），表明某些疫苗的半剂量甚至四分之一剂量可产生与高疫苗效力相关的免疫反应。随后，我们使用SEIR模型估计，在这些效力水平下，通过使用分数剂量将疫苗接种速度提高一倍或三倍，将大幅减少感染和死亡率。由于免疫反应与效力之间的相关性可能无法完全预测分数剂量的效力，我们随后使用SEIR模型表明，在广泛的合理效力水平范围内，分数剂量接种将大幅减少感染和死亡率。针对一系列疫苗和剂量组合的进一步免疫原性研究可在数周内得出结果，并可在数百名健康志愿者中开展。国家监管机构还可决定在疫苗接种活动的背景下，基于现有免疫反应数据测试分数剂量的效力，正如一些机构对延迟第二剂所做的那样。如果效力结果较高，该方法可广泛实施；而如果效力结果较低，可通过向已接种分数剂量者给予全剂量来限制下行风险。SEIR模型还表明，延迟第二剂疫苗可能会对多种（但并非所有）疫苗-变异株组合产生显著的死亡率收益，凸显了持续监测的重要性。最后，我们发现，对于在立即获得的已批准但效力较低的疫苗与等待mRNA疫苗之间做选择的国家，使用立即获得的疫苗通常可降低死亡率。
title: Could Vaccine Dose Stretching Reduce COVID-19 Deaths?
title_zh: 疫苗剂量拉伸能否减少COVID-19死亡？

abstract: We study the role of insurance companies in propagating liquidity shocks to the real economy. We use natural disasters as our instrument to identify exogenous shifts in capital-market liquidity, and study whether capital-market liquidity affects regional-level fiscal conditions and output. Aggregate disaster-driven bonds sales of disaster-unaffected municipal bonds by exposed insurers cause low GDP growth and high unemployment. In micro data, natural disasters trigger large, unexpected redemptions of property-insurance contracts, causing: fire sales of municipal bonds; increased borrowing costs in primary markets; decreased muni issuance; lower investment in muni-reliant sectors. Therefore, insurance companies do propagate liquidity shocks to the real economy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究保险公司在将流动性冲击传导至实体经济中的作用。我们以自然灾害作为工具，识别资本市场流动性的外生变动，并研究资本市场流动性是否影响区域层面的财政状况和产出。受灾害影响的保险公司出售未受灾害影响市政债券所引发的、由灾害驱动的总体债券抛售，导致低GDP增长和高失业率。在微观数据中，自然灾害引发财产保险合约的大规模意外赎回，进而导致：市政债券的贱卖；一级市场借贷成本上升；市政债券发行减少；对依赖市政部门的行业投资下降。因此，保险公司确实将流动性冲击传导至实体经济。
title: Insurance Companies and the Propagation of Liquidity Shocks to the Real Economy
title_zh: 保险公司与流动性冲击向实体经济的传导

abstract: We study the role of social network structure in peer-to-peer educational spillovers by leveraging a two-year field experiment in primary schools in rural Bangladesh. We implement a randomized educational intervention-the provision of free after-school tutoring-offered to a random subsample of students in treatment schools. We exploit the experimentally induced across-classroom variation in the centrality of treated students to provide the first causal evidence of centrality-based spillover effects. We find that a one standard deviation (SD) increase in the average centrality of treated students within a classroom leads to improvements in the test scores of their untreated classmates of 0.57 SD in English and 0.62 SD in math. Further evidence indicates that more central students have higher academic ability, better social skills, and interact more with classmates on matters related to learning, which suggests that they can be more influential for their peers. In addition, we offer the private tutoring intervention to the most central students on a separate group of schools. We find that this targeted approach provides larger educational benefits both for treated and untreated students than the policy that treats a random subset of students. We conclude that targeting the most central students in a network to offer an intervention can be a cost-effective way to improve the educational outcomes of all students in a classroom.
abstract_zh: 我们通过利用在孟加拉国农村小学开展的一项为期两年的实地实验，研究社会网络结构在同伴教育溢出效应中的作用。我们实施了一项随机教育干预——提供免费课后辅导——并将其提供给治疗学校中随机抽取的一部分学生。我们利用实验所诱导的班级间差异，即受治疗学生中心性的差异，首次提供基于中心性的溢出效应的因果证据。我们发现，班级内受治疗学生平均中心性提高一个标准差（SD），会使其未受治疗同学的考试成绩提高：英语提高0.57个标准差，数学提高0.62个标准差。进一步证据表明，中心性更高的学生具有更高的学业能力、更好的社交技能，并在与学习相关的事务上与同学互动更多，这表明他们可能对同伴更具影响力。此外，我们在另一组学校中向最中心的学生提供私人辅导干预。我们发现，与随机治疗一部分学生的政策相比，这种针对性方法为受治疗和未受治疗学生都带来了更大的教育收益。我们得出结论，针对网络中最中心的学生提供干预，可能是改善班级中所有学生教育成果的一种具有成本效益的方式。

title: Centrality-Based Spillover Effects
title_zh: 基于中心性的溢出效应

abstract: We study the effects of patent scope and review times on startups and externalities on their rivals. We leverage the quasi-random assignment of U.S. patent applications to examiners and find that grant delays reduce a startup’s employment and sales growth, chances of survival, access to external capital, and future innovation. Delays also harm the growth, access to external capital, and follow-on innovation of the patentee’s rivals, suggesting that quick patents enhance both inventor rewards and generate positive externalities. Broader scope increases a startup’s future growth (conditional on survival) and innovation but imposes negative externalities on its rivals’ growth.
abstract_zh: 我们研究专利范围和审查时间对初创企业的影响及其对竞争对手的外部性。我们利用美国专利申请向审查员准随机分配这一机制，发现授权延迟会降低初创企业的就业和销售增长、生存机会、外部资本获取能力以及未来创新。延迟还会损害专利权人竞争对手的增长、外部资本获取和后续创新，这表明快速授权既能增强发明人回报，也能产生正外部性。更宽的范围会提高初创企业的未来增长（以生存为条件）和创新，但会对其竞争对手的增长施加负外部性。
title: Quick or Broad Patents? Evidence from U.S. Startups
title_zh: 快速还是广泛专利？来自美国初创企业的证据

abstract: We provide a theory of trading through intermediaries in OTC markets. The role of intermediaries is to sustain unsecured trade. When agents trade without collateral, total surplus can increase. In our model, traders are connected through a network. Agents observe their neighbors' actions, and can trade with their counterparty in a given period through a path of intermediaries in the network. If trade is unsecured, agents can renege on their obligations. We show that trading through a network is essential to support unsecured trade, when agents infrequently meet the same counterparty in the market. However, intermediaries must receive fees to have the incentive to implement unsecured trades. While trade without collateral can be sustained in many networks, the efficiency gains are higher in a star network. The center agent in a star can receive higher fees as well. Moreover, concentrated intermediation is a stable structure, when agents incur linking costs.
title: Endogenous Intermediation in Over-the-Counter Markets
title_zh: 场外市场中的内生中介

abstract: We model the allocation of property crime and private protection within cities. We provide a theory where city-specific criminals choose a neighborhood and whether they pay a search cost to compare potential victims, whereas households invest in self-protection. The model features strategic complementarity between criminals' search efforts and households' protection investments. As criminals' return to search increases with neighborhood wealth, households in rich neighborhoods are more likely to enter a rat race to ever greater protection that drives criminals towards poorer areas. The mechanisms of our model are tested with the Canadian General Social Survey. Household protection increases with household and neighborhood incomes, neighborhood protection, and neighborhood victimization.
title: Property crime and private protection allocation within cities: theory and evidence
title_zh: 城市内财产犯罪与私人保护配置：理论与证据

abstract: We examine the portfolio choice of an investor with generalized disappointment-aversion preferences who faces log returns described by a normal-exponential model. We derive a three-fund separation strategy: the investor allocates wealth to a risk-free asset, a standard mean-variance efficient fund, and an additional fund reflecting return asymmetries. The optimal portfolio is characterized by the investor’s endogenous effective risk aversion and implicit asymmetry aversion. In empirical applications, we find that disappointment aversion is associated with much larger asymmetry aversion than are standard preferences. Our model explains patterns in popular portfolio advice across both risk appetites and investment horizons. Received November 12, 2015; editorial decision July 20, 2016 by Editor Stefan Nagel.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了一位具有广义失望厌恶偏好、且面临由正态-指数模型所描述的对数收益的投资者的投资组合选择。我们推导出三基金分离策略：投资者将财富配置于无风险资产、一个标准的均值-方差有效基金，以及一个反映收益不对称性的附加基金。最优投资组合由投资者内生的有效风险厌恶和隐含的不对称厌恶来刻画。在实证应用中，我们发现，与标准偏好相比，失望厌恶与大得多的不对称厌恶相关。我们的模型解释了广受欢迎的投资组合建议在风险偏好和投资期限上的模式。收稿日期2015年11月12日；编辑决定日期2016年7月20日，由编辑Stefan Nagel作出。
title: Asymmetries and Portfolio Choice
title_zh: 不对称性与投资组合选择

abstract: Some of the best-known papers of Carlos F. Díaz Alejandro were about Latin America's crises in the 1980s and 1930s.I will show data, figures and evidence here about the crises in the advanced economies 30 years later that fit the same narrative.His unadulterated words aptly describe modern problems across geographical borders and, in this case, income levels.This attests to his timeless insight and understanding.Because some of the observations he made have general applicability to the study of recurring patterns across crises, I have taken the liberty to label these as lessons.
abstract_zh: 卡洛斯·F·迪亚斯·亚历杭德罗的一些最著名论文是关于20世纪80年代和30年代拉丁美洲的危机。我将在此展示30年后发达经济体危机的数据、图表和证据，这些都与相同的叙事相吻合。他原汁原味的话语恰如其分地描述了跨越地理边界、在此情况下也跨越收入水平的现代问题。这证明了他超越时代的洞察力和理解力。由于他的一些观察对于研究危机中反复出现的模式具有普遍适用性，我冒昧地将这些称为教训。
title: The Antecedents and Aftermath of Financial Crises as told by Carlos F. Díaz Alejandro
title_zh: 卡洛斯·F·迪亚斯·亚历杭德罗所讲述的金融危机前因与后果

abstract: we examine whether more Chinese aid is allocated to the political leaders' birth regions and regions populated by the ethnic group to which the leader belongs, controlling for indicators of need and various fixed effects. We have collected data on 117 African leaders' birthplaces and ethnic groups and geocoded 1,650 Chinese development finance projects across 3,097 physical locations committed to Africa over the 2000-2012 period. Our econometric results show that current political leaders' birth regions receive substantially larger financial flows from China than other regions. On the contrary, when we replicate the analysis for the World Bank, our regressions with region-fixed effects show no evidence of such favoritism. For Chinese and World Bank aid alike, we also find no evidence that African leaders direct more aid to areas populated by groups who share their ethnicity, when controlling for region-fixed effects.
abstract_zh: 我们考察在控制需求指标和各种固定效应的情况下，中国援助是否更多分配给政治领导人的出生地区以及该领导人所属族群聚居的地区。我们收集了117位非洲领导人的出生地和族群数据，并对2000—2012年间承诺用于非洲的1650个中国发展融资项目在3097个实际地点进行了地理编码。我们的计量经济学结果表明，现任政治领导人的出生地区从中国获得的资金流显著多于其他地区。相反，当我们对世界银行重复这一分析时，带有地区固定效应的回归并未显示出这种偏袒的证据。对于中国援助和世界银行援助而言，在控制地区固定效应后，我们同样没有发现证据表明非洲领导人会将更多援助导向与其同族群聚居的地区。

abstract: We use the Becker-DeGroot-Marschak (BDM) mechanism to estimate willingness to pay (WTP) for and heterogeneous impacts of clean water technology through a field experiment in Ghana. Although WTP is low relative to cost, demand is inelastic at low prices. Short-run treatment effects are positive throughout the WTP distribution. After 1 year, use and benefits are both increasing in WTP, with negative effects on low-WTP households. Combining estimated treatment effects with households’ WTP implies valuations of health benefits much smaller than typically used by policy makers. We explore differences between BDM and take-it-or-leave-it valuations and make recommendations for implementing BDM in the field.
abstract_zh: 我们采用贝克尔-德格鲁特-马沙克（BDM）机制，通过加纳的一项实地实验，估计了清洁水技术的支付意愿（WTP）及其异质性影响。尽管支付意愿相对于成本较低，但在低价位时需求缺乏弹性。短期处理效应在整个支付意愿分布上均为正。一年后，使用和收益均随支付意愿增加而增加，对低支付意愿家庭则产生负面影响。将估计的处理效应与家庭的支付意愿相结合，意味着对健康收益的估值远低于政策制定者通常采用的估值。我们探讨了BDM与“接受或放弃”估值之间的差异，并为在实地实施BDM提出了建议。
title: Eliciting and Utilizing Willingness to Pay: Evidence from Field Trials in Northern Ghana

abstract: We analyze how Artificial Intelligence (AI) reshapes global knowledge work in a two-region world where firms organize production hierarchically to use knowledge efficiently: the most knowledgeable individuals specialize in problem-solving, while others perform routine work. Before AI, the Advanced Economy specializes in problem-solving services, whereas the Emerging Economy focuses on routine work. AI converts compute — which is located in the Advanced Economy — into autonomous “AI agents” that perfectly substitute for humans with a given level of knowledge. Basic AI reduces the Advanced Economy’s net exports of problem-solving services, potentially reversing pre-AI trade patterns. In contrast, sophisticated AI expands these exports, reinforcing existing trade patterns. Finally, we show that a global ban on AI autonomy redistributes AI’s gains toward lower-skilled workers, while a regional ban — such as prohibiting autonomy only in the Emerging Economy — offers little benefit to lower-skilled workers and harms the most knowledgeable individuals in that region.

abstract: This paper studies the local labor-market effects of Indonesia’s voluntary export ban on unprocessed nickel and bauxite in 2014, previously a major source of export revenue. Exploiting plausibly exogenous variation in the timing of the ban, opening of new processing facilities, and the location of Indonesia's mineral deposits, we find that — after an initial dip — major investments in nickel processing increased employment in nickel mining districts. New smelters drove structural change, shifting jobs from agriculture to mining and manufacturing. In sharp contrast, the ban only led to very limited investment in bauxite processing, causing bauxite production and local employment to fall. We also find that nickel processing raised mining employment in Indonesia's coal districts, which provide the main source of energy for nickel processing.
